skill.name: quiz-generator
skill.description: Creates 50-question interactive chapter quizzes for a Quiz component, with balanced answer positions, source fields, explanations, and validation guidance.
skill.summary: Builds comprehensive Quiz component assessments with randomized answer distribution and immediate feedback.
skill.author: 92Bilal26

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting and educational validation language. Two filesystem findings are confirmed because helper scripts rewrite the user-supplied quiz file without path restrictions or backups. No prompt injection, credential access, or exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts overwrite the path supplied on the command line.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict writes to intended Markdown quiz files, refuse paths outside the project workspace, and create a backup before rewriting content.

content.value_statement: Long chapter assessments can become shallow, biased, or hard to validate. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a structured quiz workflow.
actual_capabilities: Creates a 50-question bank for a chapter-level Quiz component.
Requires four options, one correct answer index, explanation, and source per question.
Guides balanced answer distribution across indexes 0 through 3.
Provides validation checklists for option length, JSX syntax, naming, and source attribution.
Uses bundled scripts to redistribute answer positions in Markdown quiz files.
limitations: It depends on accurate chapter source material supplied by the user.
It cannot guarantee subject accuracy without human review.
The helper scripts overwrite the target file and should be used on backups.
It does not provide a standalone quiz renderer or grading system.

use_cases.title: Create Chapter Assessments
use_cases.description: Turn a multi-lesson chapter into a complete interactive quiz with immediate feedback.

use_cases.title: Improve Question Quality
use_cases.description: Replace recall questions with conceptual scenarios that test application and analysis.

use_cases.title: Validate Quiz Readiness
use_cases.description: Check answer distribution, option lengths, source fields, explanations, and component syntax before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Chapter Quiz
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a 50-question Quiz component assessment for chapter 3. Cover every lesson and include source fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Quiz
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current chapter quiz with this skill. Fix recall questions, weak distractors, uneven option lengths, and missing sources.

prompt_templates.title: Balance Answer Distribution
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the answer redistribution workflow on my quiz file. Apply sequence A and verify the final index counts and explanation references.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Full Quiz Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform the complete validation checklist for this generated quiz. Report question count, cognitive level, option-length bias, distribution, syntax, and source attribution.

output_examples.input: A teacher asks for a quiz for a chapter with five lessons.
output: A 50-question chapter assessment that covers each lesson.
Each question includes four options, feedback, and a lesson source.
The final quiz uses randomized batches for repeated practice.

output_examples.input: A generated quiz has too many correct answers in one position.
output: A revised answer distribution plan with balanced positions.
A reminder to recheck explanation references after option swaps.
A validation summary for the final counts.

output_examples.input: A reviewer needs a pre-publication quality pass.
output: A checklist report covering question count, sources, syntax, and explanations.
Clear notes for any weak distractors or biased option lengths.
Concrete fixes before the quiz is published.

best_practices: Provide complete chapter content before asking for final quiz generation.
Manually check option word counts for all 50 questions before publishing.
Run the redistribution script only on files that are backed up or version controlled.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill for short static quiz lists without the Quiz component.
Do not accept recall-heavy questions when the goal is conceptual assessment.
Do not run helper scripts on unrelated files or untracked work.

faq.question: Does this skill create static Markdown quizzes?
faq.answer: No. It targets interactive Quiz component assessments with immediate feedback.

faq.question: How many questions does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects exactly 50 questions so repeated attempts can show different batches.

faq.question: Can it validate answer distribution?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives distribution targets and includes scripts for redistributing answer positions.

faq.question: Does it check option length bias?
faq.answer: It requires manual word-count checks and gives rules for equal-length options.

faq.question: Does it need a Quiz component already installed?
faq.answer: Yes. The target project must provide the Quiz component that renders the assessment.

faq.question: Is human review still needed?
faq.answer: Yes. A subject expert should review accuracy, difficulty, and final rendering.
